title: Retrieval Execution Plan Contract (strict, v0.5.0 execute mode)
description: Strict v0.5.0 plan contract. Used ONLY when the wrapper is invoked in execute mode (--Mode execute / --Execute / -BatchInput). The v0.4.0 plan-only output is unchanged and validated against urn:opencode-global:contracts:retrieval-plan-base:v1, NOT against this contract. Required fields: mode (const 'execute'), execution (with required estimated_calls, budget_enforcement, progressive_disclosure, preflight, repositories_searched), and adapter_signature (sha256 of scope_fingerprint + strategy + provider + normalized_query_lower). The composite scope_fingerprint lives in repository-state, not here. additionalProperties: false.

adapter_signature.description: sha256 of repository_state.scope_fingerprint + strategy + provider + normalized_query_lower. Computed once per (scope, query, strategy, provider) tuple.
